channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How Jensen Huang Made Humiliation Routine at Nvidia
item.description: The Nvidia co-founder’s belittling behavior toward employees goes back decades. It once led to a confidential settlement agreement with an executive who said Mr. Huang “terrorized” staff.

item.title: NPR: Trump initially accepted the midterm results, but most GOP voters doubt they were fair
item.description: Less than half of Republicans nationwide considered the midterm elections "free and fair," according to new polling.

item.title: BBC News: Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow
item.description: The trade deal is unlikely lower food prices for shoppers, but should boost the economy more than other post-Brexit agreements.

item.title: The Guardian: Richard Avedon’s rarely seen portraits of Hollywood A-listers – in pictures
item.description: After consulting on the production of the 1957 musical Funny Face, which was loosely based on his own life as a young photographer, Richard Avedon considered leaving photography behind to pursue film directing. Although…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Mamdani unveils plan to close New York’s Rikers Island by 2032
item.description: The plan would replace the jail complex with four smaller jails and reduce the number of people behind bars.

item.title: Ars Technica: Valve says it might have to raise the price of supply-limited Steam Machines
item.description: "We don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price..."

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Leaked: How Silicon Valley Elites Bankrolled an Anti-Migrant, Pro-Israel Propaganda Machine
item.description: Documents reveal the sordid inner workings of Visegrad24, an obscure Polish influence operation that became one of Elon Musk’s favorite sources of fake news.

item.title: WIRED Science: El Niño Is Driving a Record Marine Heat Wave Off the California Coast
item.description: The extreme heat extends hundreds of meters below the ocean’s surface and is fueling severe storms and abnormally high seas.

item.title: WIRED Business: Internet Archive Staffers Are Unionizing
item.description: A supermajority of eligible workers at the nonprofit digital library voted to join the Communications Workers of America.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Former Trump Official Who Thinks Trump’s Staff Has Let Him Down
item.description: John Ullyot’s new book argues that better advisers could save the President’s second term.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Body Answered My Lesbian Prayers
item.description: Catholic aesthetics reached a fever pitch in pop culture this year, starting with ‘Lost Lambs’ and coming to a head in ‘The Body.’

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Childcare Pied-à-Terre
item.description: Some families are finding that renting or even buying an apartment for the grandparents is still cheaper than daycare.

item.title: Fox59: Colts releasing Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson Sr. the starting QB

item.title: Mirror Indy: Eastern Star to sell historic Catholic church building
item.description: The church had tried to demolish the structure on the former Martin University campus. The post Eastern Star to sell historic Catholic church building appeared first on Mirror Indy .
